dialogues.en: "Whoa?"
dialogues.text: "Whoa?"

dialogues.jp:
音楽室の扉を開けた途端、目と耳にうわっと押
し寄せてきたものがあった。
dialogues.en:
Before I even reached the doorway to the music room, I could
see and hear the hustle and bustle of a major commotion.
dialogues.text:
Before I even reached the doorway to the music room, I could
see and hear the hustle and bustle of a major commotion.

dialogues.jp: 目には、学生服の群れ──野郎ばっかり。
dialogues.en: What I could see, was a massive group of uniformed students.
dialogues.text: What I could see, was a massive group of uniformed students.

dialogues.jp:
耳には、聴いたことのない曲──たぶん、こと
り達が練習している曲だ。
dialogues.en:
My ears heard the sound of a wobbling and wavering song--
probably the song Kotori's group is practicing.
dialogues.text:
My ears heard the sound of a wobbling and wavering song--
probably the song Kotori's group is practicing.

dialogues.jp: （人がたくさんいやがる……）
dialogues.en: "(It's probably because of this huge crowd...)"
dialogues.text: "(It's probably because of this huge crowd...)"

dialogues.jp:
すし詰めってのは、こんな状態の事を言うのだ
ろう。
dialogues.en:
My reading of the situation quickly found it's way into my
thoughts.
dialogues.text:
My reading of the situation quickly found it's way into my
thoughts.

dialogues.jp:
（こんな環境の中、練習しなきゃならないこと
　り達も気の毒だよな……）
dialogues.en:
"(To have to practice in this kind of environment, it must
be horrible for Kotori and her friends...)"
dialogues.text:
"(To have to practice in this kind of environment, it must
be horrible for Kotori and her friends...)"

dialogues.jp: って、俺もその一員か。
dialogues.en: ...Then again, I am part of that environment.
dialogues.text: ...Then again, I am part of that environment.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、今朝、ことりが自分で、練習を見に来
てくれと言ったはず。
dialogues.en:
But this morning, Kotori asked me herself to watch her
practice.
dialogues.text:
But this morning, Kotori asked me herself to watch her
practice.

dialogues.jp:
そして、こいつら全員にそんな言葉を掛けたは
ずはないのだから……、
dialogues.en:
And I highly doubt all these people were afforded the same
honour...
dialogues.text:
And I highly doubt all these people were afforded the same
honour...

dialogues.jp:
（こいつらが良くて、俺が駄目って事はないよ
　な。うん）
dialogues.en: "(So I'm not like the rest of these idiots. Right.)"
dialogues.text: "(So I'm not like the rest of these idiots. Right.)"

dialogues.jp: 自分に言い聞かせ、早速人間ドリルと化す。
dialogues.en:
Re-assuring myself, I drill right through the mass of
students.
dialogues.text:
Re-assuring myself, I drill right through the mass of
students.

dialogues.jp: 「おりゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Coming through~"
dialogues.text: "Coming through~"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「うわっ」
dialogues.en: "Wahh!"
dialogues.text: "Wahh!"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「とりゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Mrrph!"
dialogues.text: "Mrrph!"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「あっ？」
dialogues.en: "Ah?"
dialogues.text: "Ah?"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「えいりゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "One more!"
dialogues.text: "One more!"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「うおっと」
dialogues.en: "Whoa!"
dialogues.text: "Whoa!"

dialogues.jp:
自分の肉をこそげ落とすようなドリル行を経る
事数分。
dialogues.en: I drilled through the crowd, as if looking for treasure.
dialogues.text: I drilled through the crowd, as if looking for treasure.

dialogues.jp: ついに俺は、エルドラドへと到着した！
dialogues.en: I've finally arrived at El Dorado!
dialogues.text: I've finally arrived at El Dorado!

dialogues.jp: （……うおっ！　速攻で見入っていたぞ……）
dialogues.en: "(...Uwoh! Target sighted!...)"
dialogues.text: "(...Uwoh! Target sighted!...)"

dialogues.jp:
ごしごしと目を擦る。そして、改めて、ことり
の姿を視界に収めた。
dialogues.en:
I rub my eyes a few times before opening them again, and the
figure of Kotori graced them.
dialogues.text:
I rub my eyes a few times before opening them again, and the
figure of Kotori graced them.

dialogues.jp:
リラックスした中にも芯の通った姿勢、透明感
のある表情、そして、もちろん声。
dialogues.en:
Standing there looking as relaxed as can be, with a clear
expression on her face, and of course, her voice.
dialogues.text:
Standing there looking as relaxed as can be, with a clear
expression on her face, and of course, her voice.

dialogues.jp:
確かな力量の持ち主が、期せずして外へとにじ
み出してしまう圧倒的な迫力。
dialogues.en:
It entranced me to the point where I was able to ignore
everyone else in the room.
dialogues.text:
It entranced me to the point where I was able to ignore
everyone else in the room.

dialogues.jp:
何やら神々しいくらいで、普段の気さくなこと
りからは、ちょっと想像を超えていた。
dialogues.en:
Her entire countenance seemed like one of a goddess, passing
through the earth and blessing everyone with her song.
dialogues.text:
Her entire countenance seemed like one of a goddess, passing
through the earth and blessing everyone with her song.

dialogues.jp: （やっぱ、堂に｛い／入｝ってるよな……）
dialogues.en: "(She's really good at singing...)"
dialogues.text: "(She's really good at singing...)"

dialogues.jp: それに、脇を固めるピアノとベースも上手い。
dialogues.en:
Her partners on her flanks, the bass and piano player, were
very skilled as well.
dialogues.text:
Her partners on her flanks, the bass and piano player, were
very skilled as well.

dialogues.jp: こりゃ、卒業パーティーの目玉になるな……。
dialogues.en:
This'll surely be the main attraction of the graduation
party...
dialogues.text:
This'll surely be the main attraction of the graduation
party...

dialogues.jp: じっくり聞き入ろうと、目をつむった時だった。
dialogues.en: My eyes and ears were fixated on the performance.
dialogues.text: My eyes and ears were fixated on the performance.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ごほっ、げほっ、えほっ……！」
dialogues.en: "*Cough cough...cough!*"
dialogues.text: "*Cough cough...cough!*"

dialogues.jp: 咳の音と共に、演奏が止まる。

dialogues.en: Kotori started to bend over, coughing violently.
dialogues.text: Kotori started to bend over, coughing violently.

dialogues.jp:
見ると、ことりが腰を折って、激しく咳き込ん
でいた。
dialogues.en:
Her friends looked at Kotori with worried faces. The
surrounding students broke out into a series of murmurs.
dialogues.text:
Her friends looked at Kotori with worried faces. The
surrounding students broke out into a series of murmurs.

dialogues.jp:
楽器担当の女子学生ふたりが、心配そうに顔を
覗き込む。周りの学生達が、途端にざわつきだ
した。
dialogues.en: "(The cold again...)"
dialogues.text: "(The cold again...)"

dialogues.jp: （やっぱり風邪を……）
dialogues.en:
Now that she could no longer hide behind the mask, it was
obvious her physical condition was still pretty bad.
dialogues.text:
Now that she could no longer hide behind the mask, it was
obvious her physical condition was still pretty bad.

dialogues.jp:
マスクをしていたくらいだから、決して体調は
良くないのだろう。
dialogues.en: "(Don't push yourself so hard...)"
dialogues.text: "(Don't push yourself so hard...)"

dialogues.jp: （無理しなきゃいいのに……）
dialogues.en:
I'm sure that mentality is shared by all the people around
me as well.
dialogues.text:
I'm sure that mentality is shared by all the people around
me as well.

dialogues.jp:
とは言え、その心情は、俺みたいな人間にもも
ちろん分かる。
dialogues.en:
It's much better to resk one week fully than to rest one day
and let it deteriorate the next...
dialogues.text:
It's much better to resk one week fully than to rest one day
and let it deteriorate the next...

dialogues.jp:
当日まであと一週間しかない。なるべく、練習
を積んでおきたいんだろう。
dialogues.en: That way you can sing to your full potential, all the time.
dialogues.text: That way you can sing to your full potential, all the time.

dialogues.jp: あれだけ上手いのに──いや、上手いから？
dialogues.en: I'm sure everyone else feels that way.
dialogues.text: I'm sure everyone else feels that way.

dialogues.jp: 俺がそんなことを思っていると。
dialogues.en: --Huh, she seemed to be coughing a lot.
dialogues.text: --Huh, she seemed to be coughing a lot.

dialogues.jp:
──なあなあ、さっきから咳ばっかりしてるよ
な。

dialogues.en: Then I heard it.
dialogues.text: Then I heard it.

dialogues.jp: 聞こえた。
dialogues.en:
The people around me were whispering to each other in
restrained murmurs, yet every word seemed clear as day to
me.
dialogues.text:
The people around me were whispering to each other in
restrained murmurs, yet every word seemed clear as day to
me.

dialogues.jp:
抑えた、ぼそぼそとした呟きだったけれど、確
かに耳の中に飛び込んできた。
dialogues.en: Definitely I heard it... critcisms of... her.
dialogues.text: Definitely I heard it... critcisms of... her.

dialogues.jp:
そう、確かに、はっきりと。そこに非難の調子
が込められていた事が分かってしまうくらいに。
dialogues.en:
My curiosity piqued, I inclined my neck towards the source
of the murmurs.
dialogues.text:
My curiosity piqued, I inclined my neck towards the source
of the murmurs.

dialogues.jp: 音源の辺りを｛にら／睨｝み付けようと、首を巡らした時。
dialogues.en: --How disappointing.
dialogues.text: --How disappointing.

dialogues.jp: ──なんか、がっかりじゃねえ？

dialogues.en: ...Completely opposite from my thoughts.
dialogues.text: ...Completely opposite from my thoughts.

dialogues.jp: それは、別の方向から。
dialogues.en: "(These people...)"
dialogues.text: "(These people...)"

dialogues.jp: （こいつら……）
dialogues.en:
I turn around completely and see a whole bunch of students
whispering to themselves by the wall.
dialogues.text:
I turn around completely and see a whole bunch of students
whispering to themselves by the wall.

dialogues.jp:
身体ごと振り返り、まるきり壁のように連なる
学生の群を見る。
dialogues.en: Dissatisfied looks on their faces.
dialogues.text: Dissatisfied looks on their faces.

dialogues.jp: その、不満をくすぶらせた顔。
dialogues.en: Cold, criticizing eyes.
dialogues.text: Cold, criticizing eyes.

dialogues.jp: 冷たい非難を込めた目。
dialogues.en:
They knew nothing, yet spit out their vile poison in such an
ignorant fashion.
dialogues.text:
They knew nothing, yet spit out their vile poison in such an
ignorant fashion.

dialogues.jp: 事情も知らないくせに、毒ばかりを吐き出す口。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's violent coughing took it's toll, making her
collapse onto her knees, hands on the ground.
dialogues.text:
Kotori's violent coughing took it's toll, making her
collapse onto her knees, hands on the ground.

dialogues.en:
Her friends immediately ran up to her, dropping to her head
level and whispering something into her ear.
dialogues.text:
Her friends immediately ran up to her, dropping to her head
level and whispering something into her ear.

dialogues.jp: ──白河さん、もっと上手いかと思ったのに。
dialogues.en: --I thought Shirakawa-san was better than that.
dialogues.text: --I thought Shirakawa-san was better than that.

dialogues.jp: ──意外と普通だったんだ。
dialogues.en: --Guess she's no different after all.
dialogues.text: --Guess she's no different after all.

dialogues.jp: ──高い声が出ないんだろ、きっと。
dialogues.en: --I bet she can't even hit the high notes.
dialogues.text: --I bet she can't even hit the high notes.

dialogues.jp:
期待の映画が思いのほかつまらなかった、観客
のような。けれど、これは……、
dialogues.en:
I guess it's normal to criticize something if you're
dissatisfied with it, like a movie's audience. But this...
dialogues.text:
I guess it's normal to criticize something if you're
dissatisfied with it, like a movie's audience. But this...

dialogues.jp: （見せ物じゃない）
dialogues.en:
"(This isn't an official show. It's just a practice
session!)"
dialogues.text:
"(This isn't an official show. It's just a practice
session!)"

dialogues.jp:
ことりの友達ってのは、気が弱い人らしく、お
ろおろと、こちらとことりを見比べるばかりだ。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's friends were still looking over her, visibly
worried and flustered.
dialogues.text:
Kotori's friends were still looking over her, visibly
worried and flustered.

dialogues.jp:
一方のことりはと言うと、連中のざわめきが届
いてしまっているのか、真っ青な顔をしていた。
dialogues.en:
Aided by the poison from her "colleagues" and with one final
look at Kotori's pale face, I hardened my resolve.
dialogues.text:
Aided by the poison from her "colleagues" and with one final
look at Kotori's pale face, I hardened my resolve.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ〜い！　みなさん！！」
dialogues.en: "Alright, everybody, pay attention!"
dialogues.text: "Alright, everybody, pay attention!"

dialogues.jp:
大声と共に、手を打ち鳴らす。ざわめきがぴた
りと止まり、視線が集まってきた。
dialogues.en:
I shouted out as loud as I could, while clapping my hands
above my hand. Everyone's attention turned to me.
dialogues.text:
I shouted out as loud as I could, while clapping my hands
above my hand. Everyone's attention turned to me.

dialogues.jp:
かつかつとことりの傍らまで行き、改めて振り
返った。
dialogues.en:
I scuttled over near Kotori, and gave her a quick look over
my shoulder.
dialogues.text:
I scuttled over near Kotori, and gave her a quick look over
my shoulder.

dialogues.jp:
「練習の邪魔になりますからぁ！　みなさん！
　この部屋から出ていって下さい！」
dialogues.en:
"This practice session is now declared private! Everyone,
please leave the room!"
dialogues.text:
"This practice session is now declared private! Everyone,
please leave the room!"

dialogues.jp:
再び、ざわめきだす室内。隣同士で、顔を見合
わせたりしている。と、誰かが言った。
dialogues.en:
The commotion returned almost immediately. All the people
looked at each other in confusion.
dialogues.text:
The commotion returned almost immediately. All the people
looked at each other in confusion.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp: 「何でお前が、そんな事言う権利があるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Who're you to tell us what to do?!"
dialogues.text: "Who're you to tell us what to do?!"

dialogues.jp:
その声を皮切りに、ブーイングが飛び交った。
俺は、痛いくらいに強く、手を打ち鳴らす。
dialogues.en:
As he said that, the student pointed a finger at me
accusingly, and the audience started booing.
dialogues.text:
As he said that, the student pointed a finger at me
accusingly, and the audience started booing.

dialogues.jp:
「こらこら！　この部屋はなあ、許可を取って
　使用してるんだぞ！」
dialogues.en:
"Come on, everyone! This room is being used with permission
right now!"
dialogues.text:
"Come on, everyone! This room is being used with permission
right now!"

dialogues.jp:
「お前らみんな、許可取ったのか！？　どうな
　んだよ！？」
dialogues.en:
"Were all of you permitted in this room? When did that
happen!?"
dialogues.text:
"Were all of you permitted in this room? When did that
happen!?"

dialogues.jp:
ぐるっと顔を睨み付ける。ブーイングが一時止
んだ。先回りして、俺は言った。
dialogues.en:
I could feel the glares from all the people in the room
(minus three). The booing stopped temporarily, and I
continued.
dialogues.text:
I could feel the glares from all the people in the room
(minus three). The booing stopped temporarily, and I
continued.

dialogues.jp:
「俺か？　俺はなあ、ことり達のマネージャー
　だ！」
dialogues.en: "And me? You haven't heard? I'm Kotori's group's manager!"
dialogues.text: "And me? You haven't heard? I'm Kotori's group's manager!"

dialogues.jp:
言葉を止める。室内は、完全に静まり返ってい
る。意味が充分に染み渡ってから、俺は言った。
dialogues.en:
The commotion came to a halt, as the room turned deathly
silent. I had came up with the perfect excuse.
dialogues.text:
The commotion came to a halt, as the room turned deathly
silent. I had came up with the perfect excuse.

dialogues.jp: 「……なあ？　ことり」
dialogues.en: "...Right, Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "...Right, Kotori?"

dialogues.jp:
親しげな笑みを向ける。ことりは、かくかくと
何度もうなずいた。
dialogues.en:
I gave Kotori an affectionate smile. One that she's given me
so many times before.
dialogues.text:
I gave Kotori an affectionate smile. One that she's given me
so many times before.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そ、そうですっ！　あ、朝倉君は、私達のマ
　ネージャーさんですっ」
dialogues.en: "Y, yes! A, Asakura-kun is our manager!"
dialogues.text: "Y, yes! A, Asakura-kun is our manager!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ〜い、みなさん！！」
dialogues.en: "So, everyone!!"
dialogues.text: "So, everyone!!"

dialogues.jp: パチ、パチ、パチ。
dialogues.en: *clap clap clap*
dialogues.text: *clap clap clap*

dialogues.jp: 「分かったらぁ、さっさと帰る！」
dialogues.en: "Now that you understand, please leave the room!"
dialogues.text: "Now that you understand, please leave the room!"

dialogues.jp:
静寂。余裕のある怒り顔という、普段はあまり
作らない表情を連中に向ける。
dialogues.en:
Silence. I could still feel the anger emnating from the
faces of the students.
dialogues.text:
Silence. I could still feel the anger emnating from the
faces of the students.

dialogues.jp: と──ドアが開く音がした。
dialogues.en: Then-- I heard the sound of a door opening.
dialogues.text: Then-- I heard the sound of a door opening.

dialogues.jp: 一人、二人、廊下へと消えていく。
dialogues.en: One student disappeared into the hallway. Then two.
dialogues.text: One student disappeared into the hallway. Then two.

dialogues.jp:
それをしおに、学生達がぽこぽこと流れ出てい
く。
dialogues.en:
One-by-one, the students started filing out of the room and
into the corridor.
dialogues.text:
One-by-one, the students started filing out of the room and
into the corridor.

dialogues.jp: やがて、最後の一人が消え──、
dialogues.en: And when the final student disappeared through the door--
dialogues.text: And when the final student disappeared through the door--

dialogues.speaker: Friend 1
dialogues.jp: 「こ、ことり！」
dialogues.en: "Ko, Kotori!"
dialogues.text: "Ko, Kotori!"

dialogues.speaker: Friend 2
dialogues.jp: 「こ、ことり！」
dialogues.en: "Ko, Kotori!"
dialogues.text: "Ko, Kotori!"

dialogues.jp: ことりが床に、へたばっていた。
dialogues.en: Kotori collapsed onto the floor again, exhausted.
dialogues.text: Kotori collapsed onto the floor again, exhausted.

dialogues.jp: ◆学園のアイドル◆
dialogues.en: ◆School Idol◆
dialogues.text: ◆School Idol◆

dialogues.jp:
音楽室には、やたらと人が居た。大半が、男子
学生だ。
dialogues.en:
The music room was filled to the brim with people. The
majority, of course, were male students.
dialogues.text:
The music room was filled to the brim with people. The
majority, of course, were male students.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは風邪が｛ひど／酷｝いのか、どうにも思うように
歌えていないらしかった。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was singing as best as she could, but eventually her
cold took over her will.
dialogues.text:
Kotori was singing as best as she could, but eventually her
cold took over her will.

dialogues.jp:
と、そんなことりに対して、男子学生達の遠慮
のない悪口が。
dialogues.en:
And when that happened, the male students started
badmouthing her.
dialogues.text:
And when that happened, the male students started
badmouthing her.

dialogues.jp:
俺はそれが許せず、適当な嘘をついて、連中を
追っ払った。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't take much more of that, and came up with a lie
that chased the crowd out of the room.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't take much more of that, and came up with a lie
that chased the crowd out of the room.

dialogues.jp:
そして、連中がみんな去った後。ことりが、床
にへばりこんでしまった。
dialogues.en: As soon as the crowd left, Kotori collapsed onto the floor.
dialogues.text: As soon as the crowd left, Kotori collapsed onto the floor.
